name: SOLLiD Cabinetry — Custom Series
source: 20-20 catalog SCUST_A (Custom Series) + Envii brochure V.7.26 pp.22-23 for colour
note: Colours are sampled from brochure artwork. SOLLiD states printed colour may vary and recommends ordering sample doors. Price levels are the 20-20 tier number (6-11 = brochure letters E-J); they are not dollar prices. Cabinet SKUs are SOLLiD product codes from the 20-20 pack; widths and heights are decoded from the code, depth is the standard per family, and prices are omitted - SOLLiD prices by door level, species and finish upcharge. Cabinet SKUs are SOLLiD product codes from the 20-20 pack; widths and heights are decoded from the code, depth is the standard per family, and prices are omitted because SOLLiD prices by door level, species and finish upcharge. Door and finish images are cropped from the brochure pages at full resolution; each texture is a seam-free tile mirrored out of the flat centre panel of that finish’s door. Door rail and stile widths are SOLLiD’s own, from the 20-20 pack; drawer counts come from the SKU code (2DB24 = two drawers). REP refrigerator end panels finish the sides of a fridge opening; width is the panel thickness and height its depth from the wall. handRequired marks SKUs SOLLiD builds left- and right-handed; an order needs the hand appended (SB24 -> SB24L or SB24R). restrictions carries SOLLiD's own not-valid combinations from the 20-20 pack, so the designer can refuse a selection the factory will not build. restrictions carries SOLLiD's own not-valid combinations from the 20-20 pack, so the designer can refuse a selection the factory will not build. restrictions carries SOLLiD's own not-valid combinations from the 20-20 pack, so the designer can refuse a selection the factory will not build. restrictions carries SOLLiD's own not-valid combinations from the 20-20 pack, so the designer can refuse a selection the factory will not build. modifications are the types SOLLiD’s own pack names; their order codes and prices live in the binary kit files and are not included.
